== Summary ==
Decipher.com cardlists face archives (Wayback); cropped flush to black border, exterior corner pads bleached #FFFFFF; historical reference to the Errata hub column labelled "Original" (Advosze / Electrobinoculars / I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee / It Can Wait / Wioslea / Responsibility Of Command / AT-AT Cannon / Medium Repeating Blaster Cannon)

== Source history ==
Decipher’s complete website image preserved in the 17 August 2001 capture prints 1 Force to deploy and 2 Force to use.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20010817023628id_/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/images/electrobinoculars.gif Complete Decipher website image], captured 17 August 2001.</ref> This Wiki asset shows that corrected website wording. The complete physical Limited card instead prints 2 Force to deploy and 1 Force to use.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-electrobinoculars-hires.webp|Complete physical Limited face]].</ref> Decipher’s Glossary Version 2.0 marks the 1/2 wording as errata.<ref>[[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Glossary Version 2.0]], p. 54, Electrobinoculars.</ref> This website asset remains preserved and is shown on [[Electrobinoculars (Errata)]], while the original printed article uses the existing physical scan.
